SELECT count(DISTINCT t.device_code) as deviceNum,
a1.area_name as provinceName,
a1.area_name as provinceName,a2.area_name as cityName,
a1.area_name as provinceName,a2.area_name as cityName,a3.area_name as countyName,
a1.area_name as provinceName,a2.area_name as cityName,a3.area_name as countyName,a4.area_name as townName,
IFNULL((case when #{areaBoxNum} = 0 then a1.area_name when #{areaBoxNum} = 1 then CONCAT(a1.area_name,a2.area_name) when #{areaBoxNum} = 2 then CONCAT(a1.area_name,a2.area_name,IFNULL(a3.area_name,'其他')) when #{areaBoxNum} = 3 then CONCAT(a1.area_name,a2.area_name,IFNULL(a3.area_name,'其他'),IF(a3.area_name,'',IFNULL(a4.area_name,'其他'))) else a1.area_name end),'其他') as regionName FROM `vm_device_info_t` t INNER JOIN vm_order_devices dataTable ON dataTable.device_code = t.device_code LEFT JOIN vm_channel_info_t ci ON ci.device_code = dataTable.device_code LEFT JOIN sys_area a1 ON a1.AREA_CODE = t.province_id LEFT JOIN sys_area a2 ON a2.AREA_CODE = t.city_id LEFT JOIN sys_area a3 ON a3.AREA_CODE = t.county_id LEFT JOIN sys_area a4 ON a4.AREA_CODE = t.town_code where dataTable.delete_flag = '0' and dataTable.ord_status IN (0, 1, 2) and t.delete_flag = '0' and ci.delete_flag = '0'
and dataTable.device_code in
#{item}
and ( t.province_id in
#{item}
or t.city_id in
#{item}
or t.county_id in
#{item}
or t.town_code in
#{item}
)
${dataScope} GROUP BY
province_id
province_id,city_id
province_id,city_id,county_id
province_id,city_id,county_id,town_code
ORDER BY deviceNum DESC,
province_id
province_id,city_id
province_id,city_id,county_id
province_id,city_id,county_id,town_code
SELECT COALESCE(b.channel_name,c.channel_name) as 'channelName', COUNT(1) AS 'afterAlgorithmTaskNum', od.device_code as 'deviceCode' FROM `vm_algorithm_config` ac

SELECT /*+ set(enable_nestloop off) set (enable_index_nestloop off)*/ COALESCE(b.channel_name,c.channel_name) as 'channelName', COUNT(1) AS 'afterAlgorithmTaskNum', od.device_code as 'deviceCode' FROM `vm_algorithm_config` ac
SELECT COALESCE(b.channel_name,c.channel_name) as 'channelName', COUNT(IF(ac.`status` = '0', 1, NULL)) AS 'startAfterAlgorithmTaskNum', od.device_code as 'deviceCode' FROM `vm_algorithm_config` ac

SELECT /*+ set(enable_nestloop off) set (enable_index_nestloop off)*/ COALESCE(b.channel_name,c.channel_name) as 'channelName', COUNT(IF(ac.`status` = '0', 1, NULL)) AS 'startAfterAlgorithmTaskNum', od.device_code as 'deviceCode' FROM `vm_algorithm_config` ac

SELECT COUNT(IF(ac.`status` = '0', 1, NULL)) AS 'startAfterAlgorithmTaskNum' FROM `vm_algorithm_config` ac left join vm_device_info_t t on t.device_code = ac.device_code left JOIN vm_order_devices od ON od.device_code = t.device_code and od.tenant_id = ac.tenant_id AND ac.industry_code = od.industry_code left join vm_channel_info_t c on t.device_code = c.device_code and c.channel_code = ac.channel_code left join vm_tenant_device_channel_rel_t b on b.device_code = od.device_code AND b.channel_code = c.channel_code AND b.industry_code = od.industry_code AND b.tenant_id = od.tenant_id AND b.delete_flag='0' where ac.delete_flag = '0' and od.delete_flag = '0' and od.ord_status IN (0, 1, 2) and t.delete_flag = '0' and c.delete_flag = '0' ${dataScope}

SELECT /*+ set(enable_nestloop off) set (enable_index_nestloop off)*/ COUNT(IF(ac.`status` = '0', 1, NULL)) AS 'startAfterAlgorithmTaskNum' FROM `vm_algorithm_config` ac left join vm_device_info_t t on t.device_code = ac.device_code left JOIN vm_order_devices od ON od.device_code = t.device_code and od.tenant_id = ac.tenant_id AND ac.industry_code = od.industry_code left join vm_channel_info_t c on t.device_code = c.device_code and c.channel_code = ac.channel_code left join vm_tenant_device_channel_rel_t b on b.device_code = od.device_code AND b.channel_code = c.channel_code AND b.industry_code = od.industry_code AND b.tenant_id = od.tenant_id AND b.delete_flag='0' where ac.delete_flag = '0' and od.delete_flag = '0' and od.ord_status IN (0, 1, 2) and t.delete_flag = '0' and c.delete_flag = '0' ${dataScope}

select count(DISTINCT oa.algorithm_code) as 'orderAlgorithmTaskNum' from vm_order_devices dataTable inner join vm_order_algorithms oa on dataTable.package_code = oa.package_code and dataTable.order_code = oa.order_code and dataTable.industry_code = oa.industry_code LEFT JOIN vm_algorithm_info_t t2 ON oa.algorithm_code = t2.algorithm_code where dataTable.delete_flag = '0' and dataTable.ord_status IN (0, 1, 2) and t2.app_scenarios = '1' ${dataScope}

SELECT COUNT(IF(ac.`status` = '0', 1, NULL)) AS 'startForeAlgorithmTaskNum' FROM `vm_algorithm_give_config` ac left join vm_device_info_t t on t.device_code = ac.device_code left JOIN vm_order_devices od ON od.device_code = t.device_code and od.tenant_id = ac.tenant_id AND ac.industry_code = od.industry_code left join vm_channel_info_t c on t.device_code = c.device_code and c.channel_code = ac.channel_code left join vm_tenant_device_channel_rel_t b on b.device_code = od.device_code AND b.channel_code = c.channel_code AND b.industry_code = od.industry_code AND b.tenant_id = od.tenant_id AND b.delete_flag='0' where ac.delete_flag = '0' and od.delete_flag = '0' and od.ord_status IN (0, 1, 2) and t.delete_flag = '0' and c.delete_flag = '0' ${dataScope}

select DISTINCT oa.algorithm_code as 'algorithmCode' ,oa.algorithm_name as 'algorithmName' from vm_order_devices dataTable inner join vm_order_algorithms oa on dataTable.package_code = oa.package_code and dataTable.order_code = oa.order_code and dataTable.industry_code = oa.industry_code LEFT JOIN vm_algorithm_info_t t2 ON oa.algorithm_code = t2.algorithm_code where dataTable.delete_flag = '0' and dataTable.ord_status IN (0, 1, 2) and t2.app_scenarios = '1' ${dataScope}

SELECT DISTINCT dataTable.device_code as 'deviceCode' FROM vm_order_devices dataTable INNER JOIN vm_device_info_t d ON dataTable.device_code = d.device_code LEFT JOIN vm_channel_info_t ci ON ci.device_code = dataTable.device_code WHERE d.delete_flag = '0' AND dataTable.delete_flag = '0' and dataTable.ord_status in (0,1,2) and ci.delete_flag = '0' ${dataScope}
